title: MORE GAMEPLAY! Copi Cafe Episode 51 | Cornucopias
description:
Celebrating the amazing response to the last episode of Copi Cafe! Rob and Josh are grateful for the incredible support from our community. Despite challenges, we've worked hard to deliver AAA-quality gameplay footage. Exciting news! Our team has been busy developing the game and we're thrilled to share updates. Prepare for an epic episode with an exclusive sneak peek of unseen gameplay footage. Another remarkable leak awaits! Thank you for your support. Let's continue this journey together and celebrate our progress! Stay tuned for more updates.

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

00:00 - Beverage Choices
04:12 - Problem Solving 
13:12  - Player Account 
16:12  - Testing
18:39  - Community Questions
25:13 - GAMEPLAY!
